facts.fact: Ahram Online reports PAPSS works across 30 African countries including Egypt, and that the Central Bank of Egypt signed an agreement in November 2024 to join it.
Ahram Online says Instapay is licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt and runs through its Instant Payment Network, the national real-time payment infrastructure.
Ahram Online says Instapay, a mobile payments application, is licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt, and six Egyptian banks have applied to the CBE for final approvals to integrate with PAPSS.
